definition: Stuart Russell is the co-author of 'Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach'.
details: Co-wrote the standard global textbook on AI, invented inverse reinforcement learning, and founded the Center for Human-Compatible AI (CHAI).

explainer.lead: Stuart Russell is a British computer scientist (1962-). His work spans artificial intelligence.
explainer.knownFor: Notable works include Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach and Autonomous Weapon Systems: A Roadmapping Exercise.

timeline.what: Receives the IJCAI Computers and Thought Award
Named Fellow of the American Association for the Advancement of Science
Receives the ACM-AAAI Allen Newell Award
Receives the AAAI Award for Artificial Intelligence for the Benefit of Humanity
Named Fellow of the Royal Society
